rows.evidence_claim: Ranking laboratories crash when no archived rows fall within the configured window: np.asarray([]) produces floating-point positions, and family[positions] raises IndexError instead of returning empty totals. Reproduced using adapter.parse_history with two 2024-01-01 draws, real Rankings containing row_ids=[1] and a valid transition permutation, and catalog transicion_1_audaz. Reference replay('bold', 1, empty payments, empty first_hits) returns []; the parity candidate also returns empty totals. Verify with a regression test covering zero eligible rows for ranking laboratories.
